Mad Professor Blueberry Bass Overdrive — NodeTone NodeTone Beta Pedals Amps Tone Good for Best of Genres Brands Compare NodeTone / Pedals / Mad Professor Blueberry Bass Overdrive The Mad Professor Blueberry Bass Overdrive is a Mad Professor overdrive pedal, currently around $266. Close alternatives include the Mooer MOD2 Rumble Drive and the Ashdown James LoMenzo Mega Drive. It pairs well with the Ampeg SVT-CL and the Ampeg RB-110. Mad Professor Blueberry Bass Overdrive Mad Professor · pedal The Mad Professor Blueberry Bass Overdrive is a bass-specific overdrive pedal from Mad Professor, designed to deliver warm, musical overdrive saturation tuned for the bass frequency range while preserving the essential low-end punch that bass guitar requires. Mad Professor's natural, amp-like design philosophy extends to the Blueberry Bass OD, providing touch-sensitive, expressive overdrive for bass players.
